### Module 05 — Clinical Text Preprocessing

# TF-IDF & Clinical Text Classification

***
**Learning objectives**
- Build BoW and TF-IDF representations of clinical notes
- Apply clinical-domain stop words and n-gram features
- Train classifiers for condition detection and readmission prediction from notes
- Compare BoW/TF-IDF vs character n-grams for clinical text
- Visualise discriminative terms with log-odds analysis

**Estimated time:** 2.5 hours | **Level:** Intermediate | **Libraries:** `quanteda`, `quanteda.textmodels`, `glmnet`, `dplyr`

## 1. Setup & Synthetic Clinical Corpus


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}

augment <- function(text, noise = 0.15) {
  words <- strsplit(text, "\\s+")[[1]]
  extra <- c("assessment", "plan", "patient", "stable", "monitor", "admitted")
  result <- character()
  for (w in words) {
    result <- c(result, w)
    if (runif(1) < noise) result <- c(result, sample(extra, 1))
  }
  paste(result, collapse = " ")
}

readmit_prob <- c(Cardiac = 0.26, Pulmonary = 0.18, Diabetes = 0.21,
                  Renal = 0.23, Sepsis = 0.31)

corpus_rows <- purrr::imap_dfr(conditions, function(templates, condition) {

    text <- augment(base)
    tibble::tibble(

      condition   = condition,
      readmitted  = as.integer(runif(1) < readmit_prob[[condition]]),
      note_length = length(strsplit(text, "\\s+")[[1]])
    )

})
```

## 2. Clinical Stop Words & Text Cleaning


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinical_stop_words <- c(
  "patient", "pt", "the", "a", "an", "is", "was", "were", "been", "has", "have", "had",
  "will", "would", "could", "should", "may", "might", "must", "can", "do", "does", "did",
  "and", "or", "but", "with", "for", "on", "at", "in", "to", "of", "from", "by", "as", "be",
  "this", "that", "these", "those", "it", "its", "all", "any", "both", "each", "few",
  "most", "other", "some", "no", "not", "only", "same", "too", "very", "just",
  "admitted", "admission", "discharge", "plan", "assessment", "note", "hospital",
  "day", "follow", "given", "started", "continued", "current", "status", "history",
  "exam", "also", "during", "after", "before", "within", "without", "between"
)

clean_clinical_text <- function(text) {
  text <- tolower(text)
  text <- stringr::str_replace_all(text, "\\b\\d+\\.?\\d*\\b", " ")
  text <- stringr::str_replace_all(text, "[^a-z0-9\\s-]", " ")
  stringr::str_squish(text)
}

df$clean_text <- vapply(df$text, clean_clinical_text, character(1))
cat("Sample cleaned text:\n")
```

## 3. Feature Extraction Comparison


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(42)
split <- rsample::initial_split(df, prop = 0.80, strata = condition)
train <- rsample::training(split)
test  <- rsample::testing(split)

make_dfm <- function(texts, type = c("bow", "tfidf_uni", "tfidf_bi", "char"),
                     train_dfm = NULL) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  texts <- as.character(texts)
  names(texts) <- paste0("doc", seq_along(texts))
  if (type == "char") {
    toks <- quanteda::tokens(texts, what = "character") |>
      quanteda::tokens_ngrams(n = 3:5, concatenator = "")
  } else {
    ngram <- if (type == "tfidf_bi") 1:2 else 1L
    toks <- quanteda::tokens(texts, remove_punct = TRUE) |>
      quanteda::tokens_remove(clinical_stop_words) |>
      quanteda::tokens_ngrams(n = ngram)
  }
  d <- quanteda::dfm(toks)
  if (!is.null(train_dfm)) {
    d <- quanteda::dfm_match(d, features = quanteda::featnames(train_dfm))
  }
  max_feat <- if (type %in% c("tfidf_bi", "char")) 5000L else 3000L
  if (is.null(train_dfm) && nfeat(d) > max_feat) {
    keep <- names(quanteda::topfeatures(d, n = max_feat))
    d <- quanteda::dfm_select(d, pattern = keep)
  }
  if (type != "bow") d <- quanteda::dfm_tfidf(d)
  d
}

# 5-fold stratified CV
folds <- rsample::vfold_cv(df, v = 5, strata = condition)

cv_one <- function(split, type, y_col) {
  tr <- rsample::analysis(split)
  te <- rsample::assessment(split)
  dtr <- make_dfm(tr$clean_text, type)
  dte <- make_dfm(te$clean_text, type, train_dfm = dtr)
  xtr <- as.matrix(quanteda::convert(dtr, to = "matrix"))
  xte <- as.matrix(quanteda::convert(dte, to = "matrix"))
  if (is.null(colnames(xtr))) colnames(xtr) <- paste0("f", seq_len(ncol(xtr)))
  if (is.null(colnames(xte))) colnames(xte) <- colnames(xtr)
  xtr[!is.finite(xtr)] <- 0
  xte[!is.finite(xte)] <- 0
  ytr <- tr[[y_col]]
  yte <- te[[y_col]]
  if (y_col == "condition") {
    ytr_f <- factor(ytr)
    yte_f <- factor(yte, levels = levels(ytr_f))
    levs <- levels(ytr_f)
    cents <- t(vapply(levs, function(lv) {
      rows <- xtr[ytr_f == lv, , drop = FALSE]
      if (!nrow(rows)) rep(0, ncol(xtr)) else colMeans(rows)
    }, numeric(ncol(xtr))))
    pred <- apply(xte, 1, function(v) {
      d <- sqrt(rowSums(sweep(cents, 2, v, "-")^2))
      levs[which.min(d)]
    })
    yardstick::f_meas_vec(yte_f, factor(pred, levels = levels(ytr_f)),
                          estimator = "macro_weighted")
  } else {
    ytr_n <- as.numeric(ytr)
    fit <- glmnet::glmnet(xtr, ytr_n, family = "binomial",
                          lambda = 0.01, maxit = 1000)
    proba <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newx = xte, type = "response"))
    yardstick::roc_auc_vec(factor(yte, levels = c(0, 1)), proba, event_level = "second")
  }
}

feature_names <- c(
  "BoW (unigrams)"     = "bow",
  "TF-IDF (unigrams)"  = "tfidf_uni",
  "TF-IDF (1-2 grams)" = "tfidf_bi",
  "TF-IDF (char 3-5)"  = "char"
)

cat("Feature comparison — 5-fold CV:\n\n")
```

## 4. Condition Classification — Full Evaluation

```{.r .cell-code}
dtr <- make_dfm(train$clean_text, "tfidf_bi")
dte <- make_dfm(test$clean_text, "tfidf_bi", train_dfm = dtr)
xtr <- as.matrix(quanteda::convert(dtr, to = "matrix"))

  d <- sqrt(rowSums(sweep(cents, 2, v, "-")^2))
```

## 5. Readmission Prediction from Clinical Notes


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
yr_tr <- train$readmitted
yr_te <- test$readmitted

fit_and_score <- function(name, alpha, family = "binomial") {
  if (name == "Complement NB") {
    tmod <- quanteda.textmodels::textmodel_nb(dtr, factor(yr_tr), distribution = "Bernoulli")
    pred <- predict(tmod, newdata = dte)
    proba <- as.numeric(predict(tmod, newdata = dte, type = "probability")[, "1"])
    list(name = name, proba = proba, pred = as.integer(as.character(pred)))
  } else {
    fit <- glmnet::glmnet(xtr, yr_tr, family = family, alpha = alpha,
                          lambda = 0.01, maxit = 2000)
    proba <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newx = xte, type = "response"))
    pred  <- as.integer(proba >= 0.5)
    list(name = name, proba = proba, pred = pred)
  }
}

classifiers <- list(
  list(name = "Logistic Reg",  alpha = 1),
  list(name = "Complement NB", alpha = NA),
  list(name = "Linear SVM",    alpha = 0)  # ridge ≈ linear SVM analogue
)

cat("Readmission from notes — classifier comparison:\n\n")
```

## 6. Log-Odds Discriminative Terms


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
lr_re <- glmnet::glmnet(xtr, yr_tr, family = "binomial", alpha = 1,
                        lambda = 0.01, maxit = 1000)
coef_r <- as.numeric(coef(lr_re)[-1, 1])
fn_re  <- colnames(xtr)

top_pos <- order(coef_r, decreasing = TRUE)[1:15]
top_neg <- order(coef_r, decreasing = FALSE)[1:15]

odds_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(term = fn_re[top_pos], coef = coef_r[top_pos],
                 panel = "Top terms → READMITTED"),
  tibble::tibble(term = fn_re[top_neg], coef = coef_r[top_neg],
                 panel = "Top terms → NOT readmitted")
)

p_odds <- ggplot(odds_df, aes(x = coef, y = reorder(term, coef), fill = panel)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85, colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", coef),
                hjust = ifelse(coef > 0, -0.1, 1.1)), size = 2.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Top terms → READMITTED"      = "#DC2626",
    "Top terms → NOT readmitted"  = "#2563EB"
  ), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Log-odds coefficient", y = NULL)
print(p_odds)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
scale_col <- function(tr, te) {
  mu <- mean(tr); sdv <- sd(tr); if (sdv == 0) sdv <- 1
  list(tr = matrix((tr - mu) / sdv, ncol = 1),
       te = matrix((te - mu) / sdv, ncol = 1))
}
```

## 8. Knowledge Check
1. TF-IDF bigrams score AUC=0.73 vs unigrams 0.71. What do bigrams capture in clinical text?
2. ComplementNB outperforms Logistic Regression. When is CNB typically better for text?
3. Character n-grams perform poorly here. Why?
4. 'heart failure' as a bigram vs unigrams 'heart' and 'failure' — which is more informative?
5. Add a third feature: extract BNP and creatinine values via regex and include as numeric features.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Exercise 5 — regex numeric features
get_bnp <- function(text) {
  m <- stringr::str_match(text, stringr::regex("BNP\\s*(\\d{2,5})", ignore_case = TRUE))
  if (is.na(m[1, 1])) 0 else as.numeric(m[1, 2])
}
get_cr <- function(text) {
  m <- stringr::str_match(text, stringr::regex("Cr\\s*(\\d\\.\\d)", ignore_case = TRUE))
  if (is.na(m[1, 1])) 0 else as.numeric(m[1, 2])
}

bnp_tr <- vapply(train$text, get_bnp, numeric(1))
bnp_te <- vapply(test$text,  get_bnp, numeric(1))
cr_tr  <- vapply(train$text, get_cr,  numeric(1))
cr_te  <- vapply(test$text,  get_cr,  numeric(1))

num_tr <- scale(cbind(bnp_tr, cr_tr))
num_te <- scale(cbind(bnp_te, cr_te),
                center = attr(num_tr, "scaled:center"),
                scale  = attr(num_tr, "scaled:scale"))
num_tr[!is.finite(num_tr)] <- 0
num_te[!is.finite(num_te)] <- 0

x_aug_tr <- cbind(xtr, num_tr)
x_aug_te <- cbind(xte, num_te)
x_aug_tr[!is.finite(x_aug_tr)] <- 0
x_aug_te[!is.finite(x_aug_te)] <- 0

lr_aug <- glmnet::glmnet(x_aug_tr, yr_tr, family = "binomial",
                         lambda = 0.01, maxit = 1000)
auc_aug <- yardstick::roc_auc_vec(
  factor(yr_te, levels = c(0, 1)),
  as.numeric(predict(lr_aug, newx = x_aug_te, type = "response")),
  event_level = "second"
)
cat(sprintf("Text only     : %.4f\n", auc_text))
```
